# Goalrail

> A coding agent that asks instead of guessing. Goalrail installs a harness into
> one repository; the agent works against intent you confirmed, and writes the
> question down when it cannot proceed.

Every page below is served as markdown at the URL given. Fetch them directly.

## Documentation

- [Install](https://goalrail.dev/docs/install.md): Goalrail is meant to be installed by the agent, not by hand.
- [The loop](https://goalrail.dev/docs/the-loop.md): Goalrail exists for one moment: the one where an agent cannot do what was asked
- [Commands](https://goalrail.dev/docs/commands.md): Installs the harness in one repository: the OpenSpec overlay carrying the
- [Guarantees](https://goalrail.dev/docs/guarantees.md): These are not marketing claims. Each one is a published requirement in the
